Descrição da Vaga

Esta é uma posição Full-Time para um Full Stack Engineer Sênior que será peça chave na construção do nosso Core Bancário e das interfaces de usuário. Você trabalhará em um ambiente ágil, colaborando diretamente com a liderança técnica para transformar requisitos de negócio em código de produção.

O foco inicial será no desenvolvimento do Account Service e do Ledger Service, garantindo que a base transacional da Supago seja sólida, imutável e atenda aos requisitos de performance e segurança (10.000 TPS, latência < 100ms).



Responsabilidades Principais

•Desenvolvimento Back-End: Projetar, desenvolver e manter microserviços de alta performance, utilizando linguagens como Go, Java (Spring Boot) ou Node.js (NestJS), com foco em resiliência e escalabilidade.

•Desenvolvimento Front-End: Construir interfaces de usuário intuitivas e responsivas para o portal PJ, utilizando React, Vue.js ou Angular, garantindo uma excelente experiência de usuário (UX).

•Arquitetura e Padrões: Implementar e aplicar padrões de arquitetura como Event Sourcing, CQRS e Double-Entry Bookkeeping no Core Bancário.

•Infraestrutura e DevOps: Trabalhar com a infraestrutura baseada em AWS EKS (Kubernetes), auxiliando na criação de manifestos, Dockerfiles e pipelines de CI/CD.

•Segurança: Integrar os serviços com o Kong Gateway, Vault e OPA para garantir autenticação (JWT) e autorização baseada em políticas.

•Qualidade de Código: Escrever código limpo, bem documentado e testável, realizando testes unitários, de integração e de ponta a ponta.



QualificaçõesRequisitos Obrigatórios (Must-Have)

•Experiência Sênior (5+ anos): Experiência comprovada como Full Stack Engineer, com forte domínio em desenvolvimento Back-End.

•Back-End: Proficiência em pelo menos uma das seguintes linguagens/frameworks: Go, Java (Spring Boot) ou Node.js (NestJS).

•Front-End: Domínio de um framework moderno de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular) e proficiência em HTML5, CSS3 e JavaScript/TypeScript.

•Microserviços e Cloud: Experiência prática com arquitetura de microserviços e ambientes de cloud, preferencialmente AWS.

•Containers e Orquestração: Conhecimento sólido em Docker e Kubernetes (EKS).

•Bancos de Dados: Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL/Cache (Redis).

•Mensageria: Experiência com sistemas de mensageria assíncrona, como Kafka.



Diferenciais (Nice-to-Have)

•Fintech/Banking: Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento de sistemas financeiros, Core Banking ou plataformas de pagamento.

•Event Sourcing/CQRS: Conhecimento e experiência na implementação de padrões de Event Sourcing e CQRS.

•Segurança: Experiência com ferramentas como HashiCorp Vault, Kong Gateway e Open Policy Agent (OPA).

•Testes: Experiência com Testes de Performance e Load Testing.



Por que trabalhar na Supago?

•Impacto: Você terá a oportunidade de construir um banco digital do zero, definindo padrões e tecnologias.

•Tecnologia de Ponta: Trabalhe com uma stack moderna e de alto desempenho (EKS, Go/Java, Kafka, EventStoreDB).

•Cultura: Ambiente de trabalho ágil, focado em resultados e com alta autonomia técnica.

•Remuneração: Salário competitivo e pacote de benefícios alinhado com o mercado de fintechs.

Localização: 100% Remoto


Se você quer deixar sua marca no futuro do setor financeiro B2B, aplique!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


  • Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para aplicações e serviços Azure, garantindo integração de testes (unitários, integração, funcionais e segurança), versionamento adequado via Git e estratégias eficientes de ambientes.
  • Projetar, escrever e implementar templates Bicep/ARM para criar workloads nativos em Azure, como App Services, Functions, Event Hubs, Logic Apps, SQL, Key Vault, Service Bus e demais serviços essenciais.
  • Configurar Log Analytics, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, métricas e alertas, além de suportar troubleshooting de aplicações e pipelines para garantir alta disponibilidade e estabilidade.
  • Configurar identidades gerenciadas, RBAC, Key Vault, integrações keyless, e criar role assignments para simplificar e proteger a comunicação entre os serviços Azure.
  • Criar scripts e automações utilizando Azure CLI, PowerShell e SDKs, além de atuar como SME de automação para otimizar processos, aumentar eficiência e padronizar deploys e operações com foco em escalabilidade.


O que você precisa ter

  • Inglês avançado para conversação
  • Azure DevOps
  • AKS ou Kubernetes
  • CI/CD


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
About Turing



Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at



Role Overview:



We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to help with our growing global payroll processes. This role will own the Brazil payroll process but will be hands-on in many other aspects of our payroll operations through data collection, process streamlining, and entity creation. This is a great growth role for anyone wanting to expand their payroll career in a global setting.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on self-starter who is analytical and methodical, with 4+ years of experience in payroll operations. We also value integrity, team spirit, and strong organizational skills.

This role is fully remote and based in Brazil, however, this role will be dealing with payroll across geographies as we grow.



Responsibilities:



  • Process Brazil payroll for employees in the Deel platform. This will include the monthly regular cycle and all off-cycle payrolls as needed for new hires/terminations.
  • Manage workflow to ensure incoming and outgoing payroll data is processed timely and accurately. Serve as the main point of contact for the Deel payroll team.
  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.
  • Help to ensure payroll-related tax account registrations are completed as needed.
  • Work closely with our internal accounting department to provide support on payroll-related questions or documentation as needed.
  • Own data collection, entries, and accuracy across multiple systems that impact global payroll operations.
  • Assist employees with inquiries related to payroll matters.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end payroll processes and related tax reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business partners (People/Benefits/Finance) for process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Create and/or maintain payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties when required (ie. audits, payroll backup for other entities, external payment operations, etc.)



Skills/Qualifications Required:



  • Minimum of 2-4 years of payroll processing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a SOX-regulated environment is preferred but not required.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proven to have excellent time management skills to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills; ability to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
  • Recent processing experience with Deel or other third-party payroll providers. Exposure to ADP Workforce Now, HiBob, Slack, Jira, and Jibble preferred.
  • Knowledge of Sao Paulo Union agreements and Brazilian labor laws; must be able to read agreements and relay relevant information to team(s) as needed.
  • Strong communication skills, written/verbal, and the ability to interact with employees at all levels. Must be proficient in written and verbal English. Bilingual Portuguese preferred.
  • Strong MS Excel skills required (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, etc.)



Advantages of joining Turing:


  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: ML Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
We're seeking a Data Pipeline Engineer to own and evolve our exercise recognition training data infrastructure. You'll manage the end-to-end pipeline that collects, synchronizes, validates, and prepares IMU sensor and video data for ML model training.

This role combines systems engineering, data quality automation, and hands-on problem-solving in a production environment.


What You’ll Do

Pipeline Operations & Improvement

  • Maintain and enhance our multi-source data collection system: IMU sensors (via mobile app) and synchronized video streams from gym-based cameras.
  • Improve video capture software robustness, particularly handling network interruptions and operational monitoring.
  • Deploy and monitor services in remote Linux environments with appropriate DevOps practices.

Data Quality & Validation

  • Evolve our Python-based QC engine that validates data pre- and post-annotation
  • Implement checks for IMU-video time synchronization, sensor health, and measurement consistency
  • Apply digital signal processing techniques to identify sensor failures, connectivity issues, and measurement irregularities.
  • Develop validation logic comparing annotations against sensor data to ensure temporal alignment.

Analysis & Troubleshooting

  • Perform ad-hoc analysis on ~1,200+ workout tasks to classify failure modes
  • Identify whether issues stem from pipeline bugs, sensor problems, or annotation errors
  • Prioritize engineering work based on data quality impact and coordinate with annotation team on fixes

Tooling and Visualization

  • Maintain and extend our NextJS UI serving annotators, data scientists, and stakeholders
  • Create visualizations (Chart.js) for QC metrics and signal analysis
  • Integrate with LabelStudio annotation interface

What You Bring

Required

  • Strong Python programming skills, particularly for data processing pipelines
  • Experience with time-series data and digital signal processing
  • Comfortable working in Linux environments and deploying/monitoring remote services
  • Ability to debug complex multi-component systems (sensors, video, networks, sync)
  • Data quality mindset: designing validation rules, tracking metrics, investigating anomalies
  • SQL/database experience for managing pipeline metadata

Highly Valued

  • Video processing experience (RTSP streams, encoding, OCR)
  • Working with sensor/IoT data and handling connectivity challenges
  • NextJS or modern web frameworks for data tooling
  • DevOps practices: containerization, monitoring, logging, alerting
  • Experience with annotation pipelines and ML training data workflows
  • Background in biomechanics, sports science, or wearable sensors

Tech Stack

  • Languages: Python (primary), JavaScript/TypeScript (NextJS UI)
  • Data: IMU sensor streams, video (RTSP), time-series analysis, DSP
  • Tools: LabelStudio, Chart.js, Linux/bash, OCR libraries
  • Infrastructure: Remote deployment, monitoring systems

You'll Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy detective work: diagnosing why data doesn't match expectations
  • Balance pragmatism with quality: shipping improvements while maintaining reliability
  • Communicate well across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Can work autonomously in a small, mission-driven team

SalesSparx, founded in 2015, is a boutique consulting firm on a mission to accelerate healthcare innovation. We help high-growth companies, especially those selling technology and services to health systems, scale smarter and faster. Our focus is go-to-market (GTM) strategy, sales enablement, and training execution.

Whether you're managing projects, leading accounts, or building internal capabilities, your work will shape the growth trajectory of companies at the forefront of healthcare transformation. 


We value curiosity, accountability, and execution. If you thrive in fast-paced settings, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to accelerate your career alongside a team that’s redefining how healthcare companies go to market, this is the place to do it.

  • $1B+ client bookings 
  • SVS Process used to manage 50K+ sales opportunities per year 
  • 9.9/10 Client Net Promoter Score 
  • Published Light Your Sales FUSE in 2023, the only Healthcare-focused Sales Acceleration Guide in the industry 


Opportunity  


The Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager leads the operational backbone behind SalesSparx’s internal training systems, documentation structure, and methodology governance. 


This professional maintains the single source of truth for internal processes, training curricula, templates, and onboarding structures. They ensure consultants follow the right learning paths, have access to accurate materials, and that our methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) remain organized, structured, and current. 


This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role focused on execution, documentation discipline, and content operations, in additional to management responsibilities. In the short term this person will develop the content to support our operational process and over time will build up its own team. 


What You’ll Do  

Process Documentation & Knowledge Extraction  

  • Interview team members, shadow workflows, and extract tribal knowledge. 
  • Translate informal processes into clear documentation, SOPs, and structured modules. 
  • Maintain an organized, version-controlled process repository. 
  • Ensure internal methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) are accurately documented and regularly updated. 

Template Governance & Content Maintenance  

  • Own the lifecycle and organization of: SVS materials, Go-to-Market assets and Internal consulting templates 
  • Audit and update templates on a defined cadence. 
  • Enforce consistency, version control, and internal standards for all materials. 
  • Maintain a centralized template library that is easy for consultants to access and navigate. 

Training Curriculum & LMS Development  

  • Convert existing training materials into structured LMS modules. 
  • Build quizzes, assessments, practice exercises, and progress tracking workflows. 
  • Maintain curriculum versions and ensure training content remains aligned to current methodology. 
  • Support training execution logistics (materials prep, assignments, communications). 

Onboarding Coordination  

  • Build a structured onboarding flow for new consultants. 
  • Ensure every new hire follows the correct learning path and completes required modules. 
  • Track onboarding progress and report on readiness or gaps. 
  • Provide execution support to the team members leading training sessions. 

Learning Path Compliance & Monitoring  

  • Track consultant participation in learning paths. 
  • Follow up on incomplete modules and escalate when needed. 
  • Maintain dashboards or tracking sheets for enablement completion. 
  • Ensure training compliance is consistently monitored and documented. 

Who We’re Looking For  


Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Business, Education, Sales, Communications, or related fields. 
  • Master’s degree preferred (Education, Instructional Design, Adult Learning, Curriculum & Instruction, or similar). 


Experience  

  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.
  • Experience on working in a Management Consulting firm is required
  • 5+ years in roles such as: Training Coordinator, Instructional Design Specialist, Enablement Coordinator, Curriculum Development Assistant, Knowledge Management Specialist, or Process Documentation/PMO Support. 
  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.  
  • Experience building training materials, documenting processes, and maintaining structured content repositories. 
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms, learning paths, assessments, and completion tracking. 
  • Experience in process-driven, documentation-heavy environments. 
  • No prior healthcare experience required. 


Skills  

  • Fluent written and spoken English. 
  • Capable to work on EST hours. 
  • Strong organizational discipline in a fully remote environment. 
  • Ability to extract insights from SMEs and convert them into structured content. 
  • Comfort building onboarding flows, training assets, and learning materials.

  • Documentation tools (SharePoint, Google Drive, etc.) 
  • LMS or course-authoring tools 
  • Project management tools (Asana)

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Gerente De Vendas
description:
About the job

We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team , building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.

  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements


  • Management Experience : Proven experience in managing sales teams , with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between global headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.


4. Job Highlights


Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE’s.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Ability to work in English


The Job:

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

The Responsibilities:

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.E. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
  • Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

title: Analista de Cobrança e Retenção
description:
Analista de Cobrança e Retenção – DS.Marketing

Como Analista de Cobrança e Retenção, você será responsável por conduzir o relacionamento com clientes em momentos críticos do ciclo, especialmente em situações de inadimplência, desalinhamento de expectativas ou perda momentânea de percepção de valor.

Seu papel é estratégico: garantir que o cliente mantenha clareza sobre seu plano de crescimento, entenda os próximos passos e execute corretamente a jornada para renovar e recomprar com previsibilidade.

Nesta função, você atuará com abordagem consultiva, combinando princípios de Customer Success, operações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e gestão de objeções, sempre com foco na manutenção da receita e saúde da carteira.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir contatos ativos e receptivos com clientes em atraso, risco de churn ou perda de percepção de valor.
  • Identificar a causa raiz da inadimplência (financeira, técnica, operacional ou de expectativa) e propor caminhos realistas de regularização.
  • Resgatar a visão estratégica do cliente, conectando o plano contratado aos resultados esperados.
  • Estruturar negociações e acordos financeiros que permitam continuidade saudável do contrato.
  • Controlar objeções com técnica e empatia, garantindo que o cliente se sinta acompanhado e orientado.
  • Executar rotinas de cobrança consultiva, evitando processos mecânicos e focando no impacto do plano no negócio do cliente.
  • Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
  • Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
  • Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
  • Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.
  • Gerar percepções qualitativas sobre comportamento dos clientes, objeções recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no produto/atendimento.

Competências desejadas

  • Comunicação clara e empática: saber conduzir conversas difíceis sem perder a conexão.
  • Sem medo do telefone, nosso clientes quer ser ouvido! Comunicação em voz é mais eficiente!
  • Perfil consultivo: entender o contexto e orientar com visão de negócio.
  • Resiliência emocional: lidar bem com cenários críticos, objeções, frustrações e pressão.
  • Negociação e argumentação: construir acordos viáveis e sustentáveis.
  • Organização e precisão: registrar dados e cumprir processos com excelência.
  • Visão sistêmica: enxergar a jornada completa do cliente e o impacto da retenção na empresa.
  • Disciplina e compromisso: acompanhar pendências, prazos e acordos até a resolução.
  • Colaboração: trabalhar próximo a CS, Financeiro e Comercial para garantir resultado coletivo.

Sobre a DS.Marketing

Empresa especialista em impulsionar vendas no varejo por meio de tecnologia, dados e automação. Democratizamos o acesso ao marketing digital para o empreendor do Brasil profundo!

Modalidade de contratação: CLT

Nossa Proposta

  • Remuneração atrativa (fixo + bônus de performance acima do mercado)
  • Contratação CLT
  • Cartão Flash (VR)
  • Vale Transporte

Ambiente de crescimento acelerado, com treinamentos e evoluções constantes

Possibilidade de influenciar diretamente os indicadores de receita, inadimplência e retenção da empresa

Se você quer atuar na linha de frente da saúde da carteira, garantir a continuidade dos clientes e gerar impacto real no varejo brasileiro, essa vaga é para você.

Vamos juntos!

  • Apoiar iniciativas de segurança da informação, aplicando boas práticas de proteção de dados, controle de acessos e resposta a incidentes básicos.
  • Elaborar e manter documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais, garantindo a padronização e o compartilhamento do conhecimento dentro do time.

O que esperamos de você:

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.

Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs), collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs.
  • Practice code versioning (Git), with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!

Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases.
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing.
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure.
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin.
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices.
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).

Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for "Embedded Software Engineer " who wants to learn and transform his career

Responsibility:

-Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments).

- Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar.

-System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints.

-Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits).

-Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure.

- Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries.

- Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

What can you expect from us?

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 2+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.

You'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.

At Velozient, we're a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You'll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient's brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.

REQUIRED Experience:

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 1+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Experience:

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.

What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!

  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.

Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.G., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.G., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.G., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.G., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-Based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.G., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Engenheiro De Software Embarcado
description:
Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

· hands-on experience in Automotive ECU development and embedded software

engineering, covering complete V-model lifecycle.

· Deep technical expertise in CAN, UDS, Diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols

with proven track record in software integration and testing.

· Expertise in Embedded C/C++, CAPL, RTOS, Device Drivers, MCAL

· Understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous (CI/CD) using Jenkins, and version control

systems like Git and SVN.

· Strong understanding of ASPICE, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), and Agile/Scrum development

methodologies.

· Understanding of AUTOSAR methodology

· Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities with a holistic understanding of

hardware-software co-development.

· Experienced in conducting design/code reviews, and driving technical excellence across cross-

functional teams.


Roles & Responsibilities

1. Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments). · Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar. 2. System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints. 3. Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits). 4. Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries. 6. Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

title: Analista De Cobrança E Retenção
description:
Analista de Cobrança e Retenção – DS.Marketing


Como Analista de Cobrança e Retenção, você será responsável por conduzir o relacionamento com clientes em momentos críticos do ciclo, especialmente em situações de inadimplência, desalinhamento de expectativas ou perda momentânea de percepção de valor.


Seu papel é estratégico: garantir que o cliente mantenha clareza sobre seu plano de crescimento, entenda os próximos passos e execute corretamente a jornada para renovar e recomprar com previsibilidade.


Nesta função, você atuará com abordagem consultiva, combinando princípios de Customer Success, operações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e gestão de objeções, sempre com foco na manutenção da receita e saúde da carteira.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir contatos ativos e receptivos com clientes em atraso, risco de churn ou perda de percepção de valor.
  • Identificar a causa raiz da inadimplência (financeira, técnica, operacional ou de expectativa) e propor caminhos realistas de regularização.
  • Resgatar a visão estratégica do cliente, conectando o plano contratado aos resultados esperados.
  • Estruturar negociações e acordos financeiros que permitam continuidade saudável do contrato.
  • Controlar objeções com técnica e empatia, garantindo que o cliente se sinta acompanhado e orientado.
  • Executar rotinas de cobrança consultiva, evitando processos mecânicos e focando no impacto do plano no negócio do cliente.
  • Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
  • Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
  • Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
  • Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.
  • Gerar percepções qualitativas sobre comportamento dos clientes, objeções recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no produto/atendimento.


Competências desejadas

  • Comunicação clara e empática: saber conduzir conversas difíceis sem perder a conexão.
  • Sem medo do telefone, nosso clientes quer ser ouvido! Comunicação em voz é mais eficiente!
  • Perfil consultivo: entender o contexto e orientar com visão de negócio.
  • Resiliência emocional: lidar bem com cenários críticos, objeções, frustrações e pressão.
  • Negociação e argumentação: construir acordos viáveis e sustentáveis.
  • Organização e precisão: registrar dados e cumprir processos com excelência.
  • Visão sistêmica: enxergar a jornada completa do cliente e o impacto da retenção na empresa.
  • Disciplina e compromisso: acompanhar pendências, prazos e acordos até a resolução.
  • Colaboração: trabalhar próximo a CS, Financeiro e Comercial para garantir resultado coletivo.


Sobre a DS.Marketing

Empresa especialista em impulsionar vendas no varejo por meio de tecnologia, dados e automação. Democratizamos o acesso ao marketing digital para o empreendor do Brasil profundo!


Modalidade de contratação: CLT

Nossa Proposta

  • Remuneração atrativa (fixo + bônus de performance acima do mercado)
  • Contratação CLT
  • Cartão Flash (VR)
  • Vale Transporte


Ambiente de crescimento acelerado, com treinamentos e evoluções constantes

Possibilidade de influenciar diretamente os indicadores de receita, inadimplência e retenção da empresa

Se você quer atuar na linha de frente da saúde da carteira, garantir a continuidade dos clientes e gerar impacto real no varejo brasileiro, essa vaga é para você.

  • Um profissional com mentalidade de compliance , capaz de transformar o controle de contratos em um processo sólido, rastreável e inteligente — garantindo segurança jurídica, previsibilidade financeira e suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica.

  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.

  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements


  • Management Experience : Proven experience in managing sales teams , with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.

description:

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

Você fará parte do time de Produtos da FM2S, que compreende as equipes de Educação, Audiovisual e de Experiência do Cliente. É desse time a missão de acelerar a carreira dos alunos da FM2S.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Liderar o time de Marketing;

title: Engenheiro Mecânico
description:
Mechanical Engineering


Looking for:

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This position

will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and

bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling,

prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all

requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer Reporting to the Staff (USA), Engineer out of Campinas.


The Candidate:

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the

concept to manufacturing journey. You’ve either built or supported bringing new products to the

world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of

materials. You’re willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on

challenges.

The Qualifications :

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE’s.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Ability to work in English


The Job:

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

The Responsibilities:

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.E. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
  • Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

title: Redator
description:
Sobre a Empresa: Já pensou em prestar serviços para uma casa de estratégia e projetos de tecnologia avançada que reúne gente geek, gente criativa, e gente de negócios? A Hagens integra Comunicação, Alta Performance, HX Experience dentro de uma cultura que valoriza ideias, iniciativas, criatividade e, com certeza, as pessoas. Bora voar no nosso foguete!

Estamos localizados no coração de Campinas, em um dos maiores prédios da cidade na Norte Sul. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente de inovação, com profissionais talentosos e criativos que desenvolvem soluções que realmente fazem a diferença.


Na Hagens, operamos em um modelo híbrido, combinando atuação remota com encontros presenciais às terças, quartas e quintas-feiras, ajustáveis conforme necessário.


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Redator(a) com habilidade de adaptação ao tom de voz das marcas, precisão na construção dos textos e atenção aos mínimos detalhes. Você será responsável por desenvolver conceitos e conteúdos criativos que atendam às necessidades de campanhas e projetos, garantindo a entrega de textos alinhados às diretrizes estratégicas e de comunicação. Buscamos alguém com experiência em redação publicitária para diferentes formatos, com domínio da linguagem persuasiva.


Como vai ser seu dia a dia com a gente:

  • Criar textos para campanhas publicitárias, anúncios, roteiros e conteúdos institucionais.
  • Adaptar a linguagem e tom de voz conforme o público-alvo e os canais de comunicação.
  • Desenvolver narrativas envolventes que conectem marcas e consumidores.
  • Propor ideias e conceitos criativos alinhados às expectativas do negócio e tendências de mercado.
  • Garantir que os conteúdos atendam aos requisitos estratégicos e técnicos, mantendo consistência e impacto.
  • Seguir rigorosamente os guides e boas práticas de copywriting de cada cliente.
  • Participar ativamente dos projetos da agência, contribuindo com insights e acompanhando as etapas de execução.


Requisitos :

  • Experiência em redação publicitária e criação de textos para diferentes mídias.
  • Excelente domínio da língua portuguesa e habilidades de escrita persuasiva.
  • Conhecimento atualizado das principais tendências do mercado publicitário e digital.
  • Capacidade de adaptação para diferentes segmentos e formatos de conteúdo.
  • Flexibilidade e agilidade para lidar com demandas variadas.
  • Experiência na criação de textos para canais digitais (Facebook Ads, Google Display, e-mails marketing, landing pages).
  • Habilidade para seguir diretrizes rigorosas de tom de voz, branding e copywriting.
  • Fluência em espanhol ou que tenha o idioma como língua nativa.


Diferenciais :

  • Experiência com ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à redação, como otimização de copy e geração de insights.
  • Portfólio com cases relevantes.
  • Proficiência no idioma Espanhol.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Executivo(a) de Contas para atuar na gestão estratégica dos nossos clientes, garantindo o atendimento eficaz de suas necessidades de marketing e comunicação. Você será responsável por construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com os clientes, entender profundamente seus desafios e objetivos de negócio, e propor soluções personalizadas que gerem valor real. Este papel é essencial para conectar as áreas internas da agência com os clientes, assegurando que todos os projetos sejam executados de forma eficiente e estratégica.

Buscamos alguém que combine pensamento estratégico com excelentes habilidades de relacionamento e comunicação.


Como vai ser seu dia a dia com a gente:

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes, garantindo uma comunicação clara, eficiente e estratégica.

  • Identificar oportunidades e propor soluções que agreguem valor aos projetos e à parceria com o cliente.
  • Coordenar o fluxo de demandas, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a qualidade das entregas.
  • Realizar apresentações de propostas, reports de resultados e projetos para clientes.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado e melhores práticas de comunicação e marketing para trazer insights relevantes para os clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Fluência ou domínio do idioma Espanhol;
  • Experiência prévia em atendimento a clientes na área de marketing, publicidade ou comunicação.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Habilidade para desenvolver e interpretar briefings estratégicos.
  • Capacidade de pensar de forma analítica e estratégica.
  • Habilidade de negociação e gestão de expectativas.
  • Organização e capacidade de administração de prazos e demandas simultâneas.
  • Capacidade de criar e manter relacionamentos de confiança com os clientes.
  • Conhecimento sobre tendências de marketing digital e comunicação integrada.


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência anterior com segmentos variados de mercado (varejo, tecnologia, saúde, etc.).
  • Experiência em plataformas de gestão de projetos (como Trello, Asana, Monday.Com).
  • Conhecimento em planejamento estratégico de campanhas 360º.
  • Cursos e formações complementares em atendimento publicitário, negociação ou planejamento estratégico.
  • Experiência em condução de reuniões e apresentações para alta liderança de clientes.

title: Especialista Contábil
description:
Vaga: Especialista Contábil


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista Contábil para integrar nosso time! Procuramos um profissional com experiência sólida na área contábil, tributária e societária, que tenha perfil analítico, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de liderar processos e equipe.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar escrituração e classificação contábil conforme normas do CFC.
  • Efetuar conciliações bancárias e correções de divergências.
  • Elaborar demonstrações financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, DFC e DMPL).
  • Analisar informações contábeis, identificando tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Apurar tributos (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ISS, IPI etc.).
  • Elaborar e entregar obrigações acessórias (EFD, DCTF, SPED, DIRF etc.) dentro dos prazos legais.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de planejamento tributário e recuperação de créditos.
  • Apoiar auditorias e fiscalizações de órgãos governamentais.
  • Implementar controles internos e melhorias em processos.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais para suporte à gestão.
  • Atuar em processos de licitações e tratativas contábeis junto ao setor público.
  • Aplicar critérios contábeis relacionados à Lei do Bem (P&D).
  • Liderar, orientar e supervisionar a equipe contábil e fiscal, garantindo prazos e qualidade nas entregas.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com CRC ativo.
  • Pós-graduação completa ou em andamento em áreas correlatas.
  • Curso em Reforma Tributária.
  • Excel avançado e boas habilidades em informática.


Experiência Necessária

  • Atuação em contabilidade geral, tributária e societária.
  • Experiência no setor de prestação de serviços (Lucro Presumido e Real).
  • Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e indicadores.
  • Atendimento a fiscalizações e órgãos reguladores.
  • Implantação e utilização de ERP (preferencialmente Protheus – TOTVS).
  • Suporte em processos de due diligence e compliance.
  • Gestão de equipe e de prazos para obrigações acessórias.


Conhecimentos Específicos

  • Domínio da legislação tributária brasileira (IR, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ISS etc.).
  • Conhecimento avançado em obrigações acessórias (EFD Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DCTF etc.).
  • Familiaridade com processos de licitações e tratativas junto ao setor público.

title: Analista De Qualidade De Software
description:
A Fitcard está em busca de um(a) Analista de Qualidade de Software em Campinas - SP para integrar em seu time e garantir a qualidade e eficiência das soluções tecnológicas que são entregues aos seus parceiros e clientes. Se você é apaixonado por garantir a qualidade de sistemas e quer fazer parte de uma empresa em crescimento, essa pode ser a sua oportunidade!


Neste desafio irá:

  • Identificar em cada demanda de desenvolvimento quais tipos e técnicas de testes são apropriados para serem aplicados, para assegurar que os sistemas desenvolvidos pela empresa possuem uma boa cobertura de testes e que as entregas estejam adequadas.
  • Validar regras de negócio dos sistemas, comprovar a correção de bugs, identificar possíveis riscos e inconsistências nos sistemas visando a prevenção de problemas futuros.
  • Ter boa capacidade de leitura e interpretação de texto para compreender cada demanda de desenvolvimento.
  • Analisar e identificar quando uma nova demanda realmente faz sentido para o produto ou quando ela talvez precise ser revista, por quaisquer motivos que sejam, desde uma história vagamente escrita, um fluxo incompleto, dentre outros.
  • Descrever problemas encontrados durante os testes de forma simples, objetiva, isenta, sem julgamentos e sem dupla interpretação.
  • Reportar bugs e melhorias de forma eficiente, onde esteja claro para o desenvolvedor e todo o time qual o problema e a melhor maneira de reproduzi-lo.
  • Realizar pair programming junto aos desenvolvedores para aplicar a cultura de qualidade em testes unitários, processos e melhorias, além de prevenir práticas que possam prejudicar a qualidade dos sistemas e processos.
  • Analisar os resultados de cada entrega e reconhecer padrões de problemas/dificuldades que o time apresenta no desenvolvimento do sistema para que possam ser melhorados ao longo do tempo.


Qualificações

  • Graduação Cursando Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins.


Habilidades Necessárias

  • Processos Ágeis (cultura Lean, Scrum/Kanban)
  • Tipos de Teste (caixa branca, caixa preta, regressão)
  • Técnicas de Teste (valor limite, tabela de decisão, transição de estado)
  • Gitflow, CI/CD
  • Lógica de Programação e T-SQL básicos
  • Inglês intermediário


Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Diferencial: Automação, API, Certificação (CTFL, BRTQB, KIKF, SFPC, SFC)


Nosso pacote de benefícios:

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação.

Cartão multibeneficios.

Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars.


Sobre Nós


Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias.

Como uma empresa global mantemos alto nível de excelência garantindo uma experiência única através de qualificação, trabalho integrado, tecnologia e desenvolvimento contínuo de nosso time.


Sua Jornada Conosco


Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.


Sobre a área


Na nossa área de auditoria, você terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional com interações e responsabilidades entre as principais linhas de frente de negócio, através disso você terá um contato maior com o time no que tange ao processo de auditoria desde o início de um projeto até o fim.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Realizar procedimentos de auditoria em áreas contábeis, financeiras e fiscais, com foco em questões complexas e que demandem conhecimento especializado;
  • Analisar demonstrações financeiras e contábeis, avaliando fluxos de caixa, tributos, custos, orçamento, e controles internos;
  • Contribuir paraa elaboração de relatórios de auditoria e emitir pareceres sobre as demonstrações financeiras;
  • Participar no planejamento dos trabalhos de auditoria, assegurando que os objetivos e estratégias estejam bem definidos;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico à equipe e garantir que o trabalho realizado esteja em conformidade com os padrões de auditoria;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com os clientes, compreendendo o segmento de atuação e suas demandas específicas;
  • Auxiliar na formação e desenvolvimento de profissionais, fornecendo feedback técnico e orientação sobre os projetos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outros auditores e gerenciar prazos para garantir a entrega dentro do cronograma.


Requisitos / Qualificações


  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Possuir CRC Ativo;
  • Excel Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento técnico e prático nas atividades contábeis e de auditoria;
  • Experiência comauditoria externa;

Benefícios


  • Serviço de telemedicina;

  • Descontos e incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições.


Se você se identificou com o nosso jeito de ser, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Aqui teremos diversas oportunidades e desafios para que você possa contribuir e se desenvolver em conjunto conosco.

description:
Hardware Development Engineer


Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering.


Job Requirements:

  • Experience with component library management (registration and maintenance in Pads, Altium, or Xpedition);
  • Experience withPCB design and layout;
  • Advanced English proficiency;
  • Must reside in Campinas or nearby areas and be available for on-site work.
